description: The requests of ./bench.sh smoke. Every entry is a GET. 'guards' says which regression or edge the entry is for. Titles and people are public catalog entries. Never add a user's handle or list: the share list comes from config.env.

entries.guards: The landing page renders, and it references the static asset that a later entry requests.
A full movie page: the title, related title links in the server HTML, images from the image host, and JSON-LD.
A full show page, with seasons and episode scores.
1e459198: a title without a poster answered 500, because the image helper called replace() on a null path.
1e459198, the other null path: a title with a poster and no backdrop. Also a show with more than 1,000 cast links.
A title with no cast rows and no related titles: empty lists must render, not crash.
A title without any video: the trailer section has nothing to show.
A title without streaming data in any country.
Grey's Anatomy has more than 3,300 cast rows: the largest page render, and the first to time out or run out of memory.
A full person page.
Fixed in 0c0825ec: 6,603 people without a department answered 500, because the meta text called toLowerCase() on null.
The gate for the endless filtered person URLs: a browser without the cookie gets the small check page, which no cache may store.
90aa853c: with the cookie, the filtered person page itself answers.
A crawler that names itself is sent to the unfiltered person page.
Discover renders its first rows on the server. It needs the title snapshot, so it is empty right after a failed snapshot load.
Discover with a filter in the URL.
The share list page, the primary viral scenario. The path comes from config.env and is never printed.
The share list's link preview image, as a link-preview bot requests it. da485db3 also fixed how the share card renderer finds its file.
A share list that doesn't exist answers 404, not 500 and not 200.
A title that doesn't exist answers 404, not 500 and not 200.
A title's link preview image, read from the cache cluster as a buffer or rendered in a child process. A generic busy answer has a lifetime of 60 seconds and no ETag, and fails here.
Links shared before October 4, 2026 name the .png URL. It answers with the same JPEG.
The public directory is in the image, and crawlers get their rules.
631ae6c4 moved build files: a script that the home page's HTML references must exist, with a one-year cache lifetime.
The metrics are on a private port only. The public port must not serve them.
A related titles panel other than the default one. The page requests it when a visitor selects a panel, so no server render covers it.
Every page requests the search configuration after it loads.
The header search: it reads the search index and the people index in memory, and sends no model call.
